ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white interior field; solid low-intensity black bands along the trailing edge and lateral tips; a narrow low-intensity vertical stripe at the fluke-peduncle junction; isolated low-intensity pixel clusters (speckling) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with higher frequency micro-peaks on the right lobe and a prominent jagged protrusion near the left distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to convex outer edges; upward-sloping trajectory toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of low-intensity circular pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips and scattered individual dark spots on the interior white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct diagonal dark linear mark on the right lobe and faint horizontal linear disruptions on the left lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dark, rugose pigmentation at the tips indicating significant scarring or tissue variation.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical line extending from the median notch towards the base of the fluke.
